state_arrays: observation(float32), qpos(float64), qvel(float64), time_s(float64) have N+1 rows; row0 is reset, rowk+1 follows transitionk.
step_arrays: All other arrays have N rows; transition_index is zero-based. Metrics columns carry units in their names; terminal empty strings mean None.
preservation: All state and numeric trace values retain their original dtype or exact float64 JSON values. String metadata is stored once, not repeated per step.
cached_terminal: If terminal_observation_source is last_executable_decision, the final observation is cached; qpos/qvel/time remain the actual endpoint.
index_defined_left_right_note: ((a4+a6)-(a5+a7))/2; diagnostic indexes only, not an anatomical sign assertion.
